statement: Can we construct our data structure using only O(n) bits of working space? Especially, can we construct it without explicitly computing array MEPal of O(n log n) bits?
context: Our future work includes the following: Can we construct our data structure using only O(n) bits of working space? Especially, can we construct it without explicitly computing array MEPal of O(n log n) bits? Can we construct our data structures in O(n/ logσ n) time when the alphabet size σ is small? An O(n/ logσ n) time algorithm to compute the longest maximal palindrome is known [3]. Can we implement our data structure so that it outperforms the simple array representation of MEPal in practice?
